title: On J-torsionless modules
summary: In this paper, we introduce the concept of JReject of a class of modules as a generalization of the notion of reject of a class of modules. We also introduce the notion of J-torsionless modules and give a characterization of regularity on the basis of the J-torsionless condition. A necessary and sufficient condition on $R$ is also given for every cyclic module over $R$ to be J-torsionless. Finally, we give a description of self-injective rings over which every module is J-torsionless.
